5020244428755.variantName: Mini Artificial Christmas Tree with Frosted Berries Pinecones and Hessian Base 30cm Tabletop Decoration
5020244428755.sourceDescription:
Bring a traditional festive touch to smaller spaces with this 30cm mini artificial Christmas tree. Its frosted berries and pinecones create a wintry woodland look, while the sturdy base is wrapped in natural hessian and finished with a tied bow for rustic charm. Compact enough for a desk, mantel, windowsill, hallway table or seasonal centrepiece, it is a versatile Christmas decoration for the home or office. The reusable design can be brought out year after year as part of your festive display.
COMPACT SIZE: The 30cm height is ideal for decorating smaller spaces
FESTIVE DETAIL: Frosted berries and pinecones create a classic wintry look
RUSTIC BASE: Sturdy base wrapped in natural hessian for a traditional finish
BOW DETAIL: A tied bow adds a decorative touch to the hessian-wrapped base
TABLETOP DISPLAY: Suitable for tables mantels desks and seasonal centrepieces
SPACE-SAVING: A practical festive decoration for windowsills and hallways
HOME OR OFFICE: Adds Christmas style to domestic rooms and workspaces
REUSABLE DESIGN: Made to become part of your Christmas decorations year after year

5075660352955.sourceDescription:
Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and resin and ceramic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Swivel Adjustment
The rotating element allows the position to be adjusted to suit the surrounding space. Set the angle before use so the item is directed where it is needed.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details

Compact artificial Christmas tree measuring just 13.4 cm, ideal for small spaces and detailed displays.
Features a swivel adjustment mechanism allowing precise positioning of the festive decoration.
Constructed from durable resin and ceramic materials with a warm white light finish.
Sold as a pack of two green trees, perfect for creating coordinated festive arrangements.
Guarantee - 1 month

The unlit design allows you to personalise your tree with Christmas lights, colourful baubles, ribbons, tinsel and other festive decorations.

EASY ASSEMBLY FOLDABLE AND REUSABLE DESIGN: Designed for convenient setup with simple sectional assembly and foldable branches that can be spread and shaped to achieve your preferred appearance. 5059442204755.sourceDescription:
Norway Spruce has the unmistakable shape of a traditional Christmas tree, with dark green foliage, a neat conical outline, and branches that angle upwards to create a naturally attractive silhouette. The stiff, pointed needles give it a distinctly spruce-like appearance, while the strong branches provide plenty of support for your favourite decorations. A strong pine fragrance completes the experience, bringing the familiar scent of a real Christmas tree into the home.
STRONG, UPWARD-FACING BRANCHES: The branches of Norway Spruce angle upwards to create its characteristic Christmas-tree shape, while their strength provides good support for lights, baubles, and other decorations. The natural spacing also allows the shape of the tree to remain visible once it is decorated.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH A PINE SCENT: Norway Spruce has the distinctive fragrance associated with traditional spruce trees, adding a natural Christmassy scent to the room that adds to the magic of the season.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: Once the festive period is over, move the tree outdoors where it can continue growing. Its evergreen foliage provides year-round colour, making it suitable for inclusion among evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH ROOM TO DEVELOP: The container provides a practical way to keep the tree growing while it is still young, without committing immediately to a permanent planting position. These live potted Christmas trees can therefore be enjoyed as Christmas trees while also being given the opportunity to become a long-term feature in the garden.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.

7085394190455.sourceDescription:
This Grand Fir Christmas tree comes pre-lit with 400 warm white LEDs and woven through the branches on green cables that blend seamlessly into the foliage. With 1,253 branch tips combining pointed and rounded needle shapes, the tree delivers a naturally textured, forest-like look that's full from every angle. Choose from 8 lighting modes to suit any festive wave effects. The 32mm steel trunk and 50cm five-leg metal base keep it rock-steady, while the 3-section plug-in design means tool-free assembly. Perfect for living rooms, festive gatherings, or as a striking centrepiece in shop windows and office receptions. This tree brings a warm, magical glow to any indoor space this Christmas.
Pre-Lit with 8 Lighting Modes: This Grand Fir comes with 400 warm white LEDs pre-strung and ready to go – no tangling, no wrestling with light strings. The green cables blend right into the branches. Choose from 8 modes for a more festive feel. Just plug into the mains and enjoy – no batteries to run out on Christmas Eve.
Grand Fir Shape with Mixed Tips: Shaped like a classic Grand Fir, this tree mixes two needle types for a more natural look. Pointed tips mimic the sharp, spiky needles of a wild pine, while rounded tips bring the soft, fluffy fullness of a spruce. With 1,253 tips packed in, it's dense from top to bottom, just rich green texture that actually looks like it belongs in a forest.
Built to Last: Made from high-quality PE and PVC materials, this tree holds its colour and form year after year. The durable needles bounce back to shape even after storage, it looks as full and fresh on its next Christmas as it does on its first.
Heavy-Duty Steel Stand: Built with a 32mm thick steel centre pole and a 50cm 5-leg metal base, this tree stands firm even when fully loaded with decorations.
Effortless Assembly and Storage: This tree features a clever 3-section, plug-in design – simply stack the three pre-labelled sections (bottom, middle, top) one by one, no tools required. When the festive season ends, the sections pull apart easily, taking up minimal space in storage. Ready to use again for many Christmases to come.
Guarantee - 1 year

Bring dark blue foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 4 artificial ficus garlands, each measuring 1.8m. Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the dark blue ficus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 4 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

8941467526455.sourceDescription:
Handcrafted 20 inch Christmas wreath for the front door, built on a solid metal base and dressed with lush faux pine branches and white cypress leaves. The display brings together traditional red and white candy canes, shiny red baubles, frosted pine cones, orange acorns, frosted berries, quaint mini cabins and green bows, so it looks full and festive from every angle. Green ribbons trail through the branches and a bow sits at the top, giving the wreath a traditional finish. It arrives packed flat, so simply fluff the branches out to the full 20 inch diameter before hanging; separate each tip with your fingers and it fills out in a few minutes.

The wreath comes with lights to add a soft glow to the doorway on dark winter evenings. A self-adhesive hook is included, so there is no drilling and no extra fittings to buy: peel off the backing, press the hook in place and hang the wreath straight away.

Made from high quality PE and silk on a metal frame, the foliage resists fading and damage and holds its shape through indoor festivities and cold winter air outdoors. It needs no maintenance, no watering and no reshaping once fluffed, and it can be stored flat and reused season after season.

Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, it works on a front door, porch, window, wall, staircase, mantelpiece or table centre. Supplied as a single wreath, it also makes a thoughtful gift for friends and family.

They come in three different appealing colours so you can buy a few and mix and match to create a combination effect lightening up the darkest and most dreary places.

So whether your lacking decorations in your home this Xmas or searching around for a fantastic gift for a friend these stars are the ideal item for you.

These stars come in a option of a 3 pack of each colour or a pack of one of each.

5096042276355.variantName: Beaded Christmas wreath kit - Wreath making kit - Pearl-effect snowflake design for handmade door or wall decorations - 10 cm
5096042276355.sourceDescription:
Build a snowflake-themed Christmas decoration using pearl-effect beads. Their rounded surfaces reflect light at different angles, giving the finished wreath a gentle lustre. The instructions guide you through the arrangement. At 10 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

Pearl-effect surfaces add shine without a separate light source. As the beads turn around the outline, the highlights move from one point to the next, bringing out the snowflake detail against a plain wall or door. Look at the design from arm's length as well as close up. Small reflective details can look very different once they form part of a larger shape, and a short pause helps you see the pattern as a whole.

Sort the beads into shallow dishes so that each colour or finish is easy to pick up. A plain mat underneath the work also helps the pieces show up and stops them travelling far if one slips from your fingers. Working under a steady light makes it easier to distinguish similar shades and check their placement. Turn the work towards the light from time to time to see where the individual surfaces catch a highlight.

If you make decorations together each winter, take a picture of the work before hanging it. A record of the colours and layout can be useful when choosing a new project or making another piece to hang alongside it. A wall beside a reading chair or a spot in the hall gives people a chance to see the handwork close up. Leave some space around the edge so that the pattern is easy to follow from the first detail to the last.

To give the finished work as a present, choose a box deep enough to leave the decorated face clear of the lid. A handwritten gift tag can say who made it and when, a small detail that turns the project into a keepsake.
Pearl-effect beads create a gentle lustre and highlight the snowflake design without needing extra lighting.
Includes clear instructions to guide you through arranging the three-dimensional beadwork for a professional finish.
Compact 10 cm diameter size allows easy placement on doors or walls, fitting perfectly into small decorative spaces.
Versatile handmade kit suitable for creating festive Christmas decorations that add seasonal charm to any home.
Comes with Instructions

Party Decorations
These party decorations add a decorative detail to the chosen display. The red finish and plastic construction give them a defined appearance for parties.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Adjustable Design
Adjustment allows the item to be set for the intended arrangement. Choose the position or fit that matches the available space and check it before use.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5056899200255.variantName: LED Cone Tree Warm White Christmas Decoration Black Indoor Outdoor 180cm
5056899200255.sourceDescription:
Create a striking festive focal point with this 180cm illuminated Christmas cone tree, featuring 462 warm white LEDs arranged in cascading strands around a sleek black frame. The tall, tapered silhouette is crowned with a glowing star, bringing a classic seasonal look to a contemporary lighting decoration. Whether positioned in a living room, entrance, porch or garden, the warm white lights create a welcoming atmosphere throughout the festive season. An included 8-function remote control lets you switch between lighting effects to suit your setting, from a gentle glow to a more animated sparkle. Designed for indoor and outdoor use, the open-frame construction offers the impact of a full-height tree without dense branches or bulky foliage. A generous 5 metre lead wire gives you greater flexibility when arranging the decoration near a suitable power source. Ultra low power operation makes it a practical choice for seasonal illumination, while the black framework creates a neat, understated appearance by day and an eye-catching outline after dark.
Transform your seasonal setting with this 180cm cone-shaped Christmas tree, featuring 462 warm white LEDs arranged in long illuminated strands for a striking, tapered silhouette topped with a glowing star.
Choose the atmosphere that suits your occasion with the supplied 8-function remote control, making it convenient to change between different lighting effects without adjusting the decoration by hand.
Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, this illuminated ornament makes a welcoming feature beside an entrance, on a porch, in a living room or as part of a festive garden arrangement.
The slim black framework creates a contemporary tree shape without the bulk of traditional branches, while the open design allows the warm white light strands to stand out beautifully after dark.
Enjoy flexible positioning with a generous 5 metre lead wire to reach a suitable electrical supply, plus ultra low power use for a festive lighting feature throughout the Christmas season.
Guarantee - 3 months

Light up your Christmas with this LED village scene, which brings a snowy winter town into the room. Set it on a table, sideboard or mantelpiece and the glowing houses, trees and carousel give the whole space a festive feel.

The scene is built on a resin-style base with painted, snow-dusted rocks and a footbridge over a stream. 5060832775755.sourceDescription:
Our Aurora Winter Glow Christmas tree brings a magical, snow-kissed look to any living room, hallway or shop display. Flocked in soft white for a frosted finish, it's pre-lit with vibrant multi-colour and warm white LEDs offering 16 lighting functions, including twinkle effects and colour-flip transitions.

Available in two sizes: 6ft and 7.5ft — choose the perfect fit for your space.

What's included
1 x pre-lit flocked Christmas tree
1 x Stand
1 x Remote control

Dimensions
6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 105cm at base, 1,234 branch tips
7.5ft: approx. 228cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1,870 branch tips

Good to know
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery
Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty

FAQs

What sizes are available?
Available in two heights — 6ft and 7.5ft — so you can choose the best size for your space.

Does it need assembly?
Minimal assembly required. Unfold the branches and attach the tree to its stand. Sections connect via built-in power sockets, so lights link up automatically. A few bolts are hand-tightened — no power tools needed.

Can I change the lighting effects?
Yes — 16 modes via the included remote, covering steady, slow-fade and twinkle effects in warm white, multicolour and pastel, plus colour-flip transitions and a demo mode.

How are the lights powered?
The tree is mains-powered — simply plug in. The remote runs on a button cell battery (not included).

Is it suitable for outdoor use?
Designed for indoor use only. Display in a dry, sheltered location.

Is it covered by a warranty?
Yes. Both sizes come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty.

How is it delivered?
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery.

Safety Information
For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries and small parts away from children/pets. Button cell battery (not included) can cause serious injury if swallowed — seek immediate medical attention. Keep compartment closed.
